title: Kiosk back-button ownership
lede: The flow header now owns the top-left navigation target without a shell status control sitting on top of it.

stats.n: The flow header is the only visible and tappable navigation control there
Hub, identity, checkout, pickup, and return keep their navigation clear

sections.heading: Checkout scan header
sections.note: Same availability-rejected DEBUG fixture and iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator viewport. The only changed behavior in the pair is the shell-level device-status button's top-left ownership rule.

pairs.title: Back should be the only top-left action
pairs.sub: Look at the header corner and the shape of the Back hit target.
pairs.beforeCap: The shell's info button is layered over the flow header, producing two overlapping capsules and an ambiguous tap target.
pairs.afterCap: Only the chevron-and-Back control remains in the corner; device status is still available from idle and success screens.

changes.h: The shell no longer intercepts flow navigation
changes.was: A global device-status button was positioned at top-leading for every active screen, directly underneath the flow header's Back/Cancel control.
changes.now: The status reveal is rendered only for idle and success; operator hub, identity, checkout, pickup, and return leave the top-left target to their own flow navigation.

changes.h: The status affordance remains available where it is safe
changes.was: Removing the collision could have hidden a useful kiosk diagnostic affordance entirely.
changes.now: Idle and success retain the existing Show device status control, while flow screens avoid a second action in a navigation-critical corner.

verification: Focused source contracts: 19/19 passing across the back-button regression, scan rejection/sound, availability, recovery, numbered-battery, and pickup contracts.
Native gates: WisconsinKiosk Debug and Release builds pass for the iPad Air 11-inch (M4), iOS 26.5 simulator; project parity, drift, iOS gap audits, and diff checks pass.
Visual: the same fixture and viewport were captured before and after the fix, and both PNGs were inspected; the final capture shows one clean Back capsule.
Repository docs: `npm run verify:docs` passes with current codemaps.
notes: This is local source/build/simulator proof only. The shell status reveal remains intentionally available on idle and success; no custody, API, schema, permission, or scanner semantics changed.
Managed-iPad interaction and deployment remain separate release gates.
